title: 相量图法：端口电压与电流同相
statement: 图示电路中 R、C 并联后与 L 串联，参数未知。已知电源电压有效值 V = 100 V，R 与 C 中电流的有效值 I_1 = I_2 = 10 A，并且端口电压 v 与总电流 i 同相。
求总电流 I、并联部分电压 V_2 和电感电压 V_L 的有效值，进而确定 R、X_C、X_L。

questions.explain: 以 V̇_2 为参考：İ_1 与 V̇_2 同相，İ_2 超前 90°，两者大小相等 → I = 10√2 ≈ 14.14 A，İ 超前 V̇_2 45°。

questions.ask: 并联部分电压有效值 V_2 = ?
questions.explain: V̇ 与 İ 同相，即 V̇ 与 V̇_2 的夹角为 45°；V̇_L 超前 İ 90°，与 V̇ 垂直。直角三角形中 V_2 是斜边：V_2 = V/cos 45° = 100√2 ≈ 141.4 V。
直角三角形 V_2² = V² + V_L² → V_L = √(20000 − 10000) = 100 V（等腰直角三角形）。

questions.ask: 由此得到的元件参数是？
choiceExplain: 这是用电源电压 100 V 去除 10 A 得到的；R、C 两端的电压是 V_2 = 141.4 V，电感中的电流是总电流 14.14 A，不是 10 A。
以为“同相”要求 X_L = X_C；但要抵消的是 R∥C 整体的电抗，不是 X_C 本身。X_L = 14.14 Ω 时 Z = 7.07 + j7.07 Ω，并不同相。

hints: 并联部分以电压 V̇_2 为参考相量最方便：İ_1 与 V̇_2 同相，İ_2 超前 V̇_2 90°。
İ = İ_1 + İ_2，I_1 = I_2 → İ 超前 V̇_2 45°。V̇_L 超前 İ 90°，而 V̇ 与 İ 同相，所以 V̇ ⊥ V̇_L。
画出 V̇ = V̇_L + V̇_2 的三角形：它是以 V_2 为斜边的直角三角形，且有一个 45° 角。
solution: **2. 电感电压。** V̇_L = jX_L·İ 超前 İ 90°，相位为 135°。
**3. 同相条件。** V̇ 与 İ 同相，相位 45°，所以 V̇ ⊥ V̇_L。KVL：V̇_2 = V̇ − V̇_L，三个相量构成直角三角形，V̇_2 为斜边，它与 V̇ 的夹角为 45°。

en.title: Phasor diagram: port voltage in phase with the current
statement: R and C in parallel are in series with L; the element values are unknown. The source voltage has rms value V = 100 V, the rms currents in R and C are I_1 = I_2 = 10 A, and the port voltage v is in phase with the total current i.
Find the rms total current I, the rms voltage V_2 across the parallel part and the rms inductor voltage V_L, and from them R, X_C and X_L.

questions.explain: Take V̇_2 as reference: İ_1 is in phase with V̇_2, İ_2 leads by 90°, and their magnitudes are equal → I = 10√2 ≈ 14.14 A, with İ leading V̇_2 by 45°.

questions.ask: rms voltage across the parallel part, V_2 = ?
questions.explain: V̇ is in phase with İ, so the angle between V̇ and V̇_2 is 45°; V̇_L leads İ by 90°, so it is perpendicular to V̇. In this right triangle V_2 is the hypotenuse: V_2 = V/cos 45° = 100√2 ≈ 141.4 V.
Right triangle: V_2² = V² + V_L² → V_L = √(20000 − 10000) = 100 V (an isosceles right triangle).

questions.ask: Which element values follow from this?
choiceExplain: This divides the source voltage 100 V by 10 A; the voltage across R and C is V_2 = 141.4 V, and the inductor carries the total current 14.14 A, not 10 A.
This assumes "in phase" means X_L = X_C; what must be cancelled is the reactance of R∥C as a whole, not X_C itself. With X_L = 14.14 Ω, Z = 7.07 + j7.07 Ω — not in phase.

hints: For the parallel part take its voltage V̇_2 as the reference phasor: İ_1 is in phase with V̇_2, İ_2 leads V̇_2 by 90°.
İ = İ_1 + İ_2 with I_1 = I_2, so İ leads V̇_2 by 45°. V̇_L leads İ by 90°, and V̇ is in phase with İ, so V̇ ⊥ V̇_L.
Draw the triangle V̇ = V̇_L + V̇_2: a right triangle with V_2 as the hypotenuse and a 45° angle.
solution: **2. Inductor voltage.** V̇_L = jX_L·İ leads İ by 90°, i.e. its angle is 135°.
**3. In-phase condition.** V̇ is in phase with İ (angle 45°), so V̇ ⊥ V̇_L. KVL: V̇_2 = V̇ − V̇_L; the three phasors form a right triangle with hypotenuse V̇_2, at 45° to V̇.
**4. Solve the triangle.** V_2 = V/cos 45° = **141.4 V**, V_L = V·tan 45° = **100 V**.
